pull_request.body:
## Motivation

SANA-Video's frame-batched GLUMB activations are much larger than Sana's image workload. Its native eager profile is more than 99% GPU busy, with **80 convolution-bias additions taking 97.77 ms per complete CFG iteration**, before the separate SiLU and multiply kernels. The existing exact convolution post-processing only runs in BCG contexts.

Reuse those fusions for SANA-Video eager inference. Two native A–B–B–A groups on **one H200** reduce worker E2E by **12.58–12.63%** and client E2E including saved video by **12.54–12.67%**. All lossless output videos remain byte-identical.

## Modifications

- Add an explicit eager opt-in to the shared convolution bias+SiLU and bias+GLU helpers; SANA-Video's GLUMB temporal block opts in. The Sana image default-stream policy stays intact.
- Reuse the existing BF16 rounding boundaries, first-sight exactness checks and permanent fallback on mismatch. Gradient-enabled default-stream calls and compiled/non-CUDA paths keep Torch.
- Keep this dispatch-only change focused on the existing helpers; standalone test and benchmark files are omitted. No new CUDA/Triton arithmetic, LayerNorm policy, approximate attention, sampling or checkpoint change.
- Update the existing SANA-Video fusion-coverage row for eager convolution post-processing.

The implementation reuses #34928 and the SANA-Video wiring in #35961. The image-specific CPU-launch regression discussed in #34015 motivates retaining the original default for image callers. This video profile has a different cost distribution. [Source review and execution flow](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/source-review.md).

## Benchmark

`Efficient-Large-Model/SANA-Video_2B_480p_diffusers@db5f398b13ca086d09a50ce156c20527773841b1`, **1× H200**, TP1, native backend, GPU-resident components, BF16 DiT/Gemma2, native FP32 linear-attention accumulation and FP32 latent/VAE policy. Manual performance mode, no torch.compile.

Official video shape: **832×480, 81 frames, 16 fps, 5.0625 s**, 50 requested sampling steps, CFG6, flow shift8, seed42. Fixed 300-token text window and native negative prompt. Prompt: `A curious raccoon walks through a sunlit forest. motion score: 30.` Same-shape warmup at 832×480/81 frames.

Baseline `993d1fccbaafe3e79d91567d2fc1d665cc94fa50`; measured candidate `275113434ffe34412f807514399ba00ef70fa38e`; PR head `64e1e8a92a1942f058b9d6c175f5342198b34709`. Any documentation-only follow-up does not change the measured runtime. Torch2.13.0+cu130, Triton3.7.1, CUDA13.0, driver595.71.05. [Environment](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/environment.json).

Fresh native CLI processes on the same idle GPU; A–B–B–A in each group. The eager comparison is repeated twice. BCG runs use actual capture/replay in both arms and provide a regression comparator. Seconds; parentheses show reduction from each group's arithmetic means:

| Group | Worker E2E | Denoise | Client E2E including MP4 save |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| eager-r1 | 44.7324 → 39.1040 (12.58%) | 41.7766 → 36.1501 (13.47%) | 45.210 → 39.480 (12.67%) |
| eager-r2 | 44.7479 → 39.0949 (12.63%) | 41.7929 → 36.1431 (13.52%) | 45.125 → 39.465 (12.54%) |
| bcg-r1 | 37.7962 → 37.7986 (-0.01%) | 34.8571 → 34.8603 (-0.01%) | 38.175 → 38.175 (0.00%) |

<details><summary>All 12 unprofiled native measurements</summary>

| Group | Arm | Worker E2E | Denoise | Client E2E incl. save | Peak reserved GiB |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| eager-r1 | A1 | 44.6694 | 41.7160 | 45.04 | 20.9199 |
| eager-r1 | B1 | 39.0674 | 36.1122 | 39.45 | 21.0176 |
| eager-r1 | B2 | 39.1406 | 36.1880 | 39.51 | 21.0176 |
| eager-r1 | A2 | 44.7954 | 41.8371 | 45.38 | 20.9199 |
| eager-r2 | A1 | 44.7547 | 41.8005 | 45.14 | 20.9199 |
| eager-r2 | B1 | 39.0982 | 36.1451 | 39.47 | 21.0176 |
| eager-r2 | B2 | 39.0916 | 36.1411 | 39.46 | 21.0176 |
| eager-r2 | A2 | 44.7412 | 41.7853 | 45.11 | 20.9199 |
| bcg-r1 | A1 | 37.7978 | 34.8597 | 38.18 | 23.6758 |
| bcg-r1 | B1 | 37.7905 | 34.8525 | 38.16 | 23.6758 |
| bcg-r1 | B2 | 37.8067 | 34.8682 | 38.19 | 23.6758 |
| bcg-r1 | A2 | 37.7946 | 34.8545 | 38.17 | 23.6758 |

</details>

Worker E2E is perf-dump stage duration before saving, excluding loading/warmup. Client E2E is the native scheduler-request/output-save timer, logged to 0.01 s. Profile and benchmark-export timings are excluded. [All raw perf dumps, configs, source SHAs and logs](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/raw), [complete evidence](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/final-evidence.json).

## Profile and operator benchmark

Each slice contains a complete second positive/negative CFG iteration. CPU third-to-fifth model/graph calls are joined to GPU kernels using CUDA launch correlations. All four slices have zero boundary-crossing GPU kernels. Both BCG profiles contain **eight single-segment graph launches**, with **two in the selected CFG iteration**; no signature miss or eager fallback is accepted.

| Native profile | All kernels | Separate conv post kernels / GPU ms | Fused conv post kernels / GPU ms | Graph launches in slice |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| baseline-eager-profile | 2349 | 200 / 168.9436 | 0 / 0.0000 | 0 |
| baseline-bcg-profile | 2023 | 0 / 0.0000 | 80 / 36.9273 | 2 |
| conv-eager-profile | 2229 | 0 / 0.0000 | 80 / 36.0984 | 0 |
| conv-bcg-profile | 2023 | 0 / 0.0000 | 80 / 36.7944 | 2 |

The fusion removes materialized bias and activation intermediates. Other native operations retain their original implementation. Cumulative device times explain the operators and are not E2E measurements. [Original/sliced traces, source attribution and three-table triage](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/profiles).

Committed-wrapper marker benchmark, rotating inputs, median microseconds. These rows include the **actual convolution and post-processing**, with normal output allocation:

| Operation | Native shape | Eager | Fused |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
| Pointwise conv + bias + SiLU | [21,2240,30,52] → C13440 | 4459.0695 | 3476.4716 |
| Depthwise conv + bias + GLU | [21,13440,30,52] → C6720 | 3127.3782 | 1174.3818 |

[Raw marker output](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/sana-video-conv-marker.log). Output parity is checked separately against the complete native convolution chain, including temporal convolution.

## Output comparison

The audit covers 26 request records. All **22 valid lossless videos**, including unprofiled and profiled eager/BCG runs, are byte-identical. Independent decoding verifies **81/81 identical frames**, SSIM1, PSNR∞, and no audio stream. The before/after contact sheet was visually inspected.

![Baseline eager, optimized eager and optimized BCG; frames 0,26,53,80](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/output-comparison/comparison.jpg)

[Original baseline MP4](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/baseline.mp4) · [Original optimized eager MP4](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/candidate.mp4) · [Original optimized BCG MP4](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/candidate-bcg.mp4) · [Per-frame hashes](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/output-comparison).

Lossless MP4 SHA256: `bd995912646f473f711d30e452891f7bd61dd594dbc6b4987d6f92bc3210f8a5`.

Separate quality/applicability matrix at the candidate, lossless/high in A–B–B–A order per mode:

| Request | Quality | Applicability | Comparison against lossless |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| quality-bcg-a1 | lossless | valid | exact |
| quality-bcg-a2 | lossless | valid | exact |
| quality-bcg-b1 | high | rejected: cannot be used with breakable cuda graphs | no artifact |
| quality-bcg-b2 | high | rejected: cannot be used with breakable cuda graphs | no artifact |
| quality-eager-a1 | lossless | valid | exact |
| quality-eager-a2 | lossless | valid | exact |
| quality-eager-b1 | high | valid | SSIM mean/min 0.938866/0.923584, PSNR mean/min 31.27/29.93 dB |
| quality-eager-b2 | high | valid | SSIM mean/min 0.938866/0.923584, PSNR mean/min 31.27/29.93 dB |

High-mode rows validate the existing quality policy and are excluded from the lossless performance claim. Any rejected BCG quality request remains an invalid row, with its native reason retained. [Quality matrix](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/quality-matrix.json).

## Validation and reproduction

**Validation scope:** The test counts, logs and GPU measurements below are historical results from the recorded benchmark revisions, before test cleanup. The current diff retains the runtime and documentation changes; the dedicated test and benchmark files have been removed. This cleanup does not change runtime code or claim a new GPU measurement.

- **12 tests passed on H200**: five new CUDA tests plus seven existing SANA-Video tests. Coverage includes the full production GLUMB shape, convolution-bias rounding, input preservation, changed-input graph replay, default image policy, mismatch fallback and gradient propagation. [Log](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/sana-video-conv-tests.log).
- Changed files passed [pre-commit and CI-registration validation](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/precommit.log).
- The one-line documentation update passed [Mintlify build validation](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/sana-video-mint-validate-node22.log) and [broken-link validation](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/sana-video-mint-links-node22.log) using Node22.
- [Upstream base CI](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/35476967831): both JIT unit partitions, multi-GPU JIT tests, B200 tests, the kernel benchmark job and BCG diffusion tests passed. The full workflow is not green: unrelated Scheduler fixtures fail in [CPU partition 1](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/35476967831/job/105987834791) (missing `_prev_prefill_end_ts`) and [CPU partition 3](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/35476967831/job/105987834826) (mock batch missing `split_index`).
- Campaign-owned weights were deleted after the final audit: **zero residual files, weight files or bytes**; shared caches untouched. [Cleanup record](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/cache-cleanup.json).

Run each clean revision with the same pinned checkpoint:

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 SGLANG_DIFFUSION_SYNC_STAGE_PROFILING=1 \
sglang generate --backend sglang \
  --model-path Efficient-Large-Model/SANA-Video_2B_480p_diffusers \
  --revision db5f398b13ca086d09a50ce156c20527773841b1 \
  --num-gpus 1 --tp-size 1 --enable-torch-compile=false \
  --performance-mode manual --quality lossless \
  --width 832 --height 480 --num-frames 81 --fps 16 \
  --num-inference-steps 50 --guidance-scale 6 --seed 42 \
  --prompt 'A curious raccoon walks through a sunlit forest. motion score: 30.' \
  --warmup-mode request --warmup-resolutions 832x480 --warmup-num-frames 81 \
  --save-output --perf-dump-path perf.json --output-path outputs --output-file-name sample
```

Add `--enable-breakable-cuda-graph` for both BCG arms. Add `--profile --num-profiled-timesteps 3` only for separate diagnostics. [Exact runner](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/scripts/run-sana-video.py), [pinned preparation](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/scripts/prepare-sana-video.py), [validation/extraction/audit scripts](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/scripts), [SHA256 manifest](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/2e3f75ee1dc52b396e839442803b6952db7ddcd2/diffusion-prs/sana-video-eager-conv-h200/SHA256SUMS.json).

## CI follow-up (2026-09-21)

Merged main `80da4432d085ed4d6166ef643d9fd2b829dbb0c5`, including the upstream scheduler fixture repair #40411 and offline DFlash fixture repair #40427. Validated merge head: `47706b7a833d22efb452d49e15bc4ccbf182fe7d`. [Merged-head validation and all logs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/f5e1b6924c3bf1b2edd494d2308046acf832acf8/diffusion-prs/ci-followup-20260921/README.md), [source delta in this PR's files](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/f5e1b6924c3bf1b2edd494d2308046acf832acf8/diffusion-prs/ci-followup-20260921/pr-40388-patch-file-followup.diff), [pre-commit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/f5e1b6924c3bf1b2edd494d2308046acf832acf8/diffusion-prs/ci-followup-20260921/pr-40388-precommit.log). The original E2E and output comparisons above remain measurements of their explicitly pinned benchmark heads; this follow-up does not claim new model-request timings. The common repaired CPU fixture suite passes 49 tests + 57 subtests.
